- Workspace-bound service accounts: See only their bound workspace.

Return the workflow's current draft as a canonical editable document.

The document has the same shape accepted by ``PUT /workflows/{id}/draft``
(metadata, definition, layout, schedules, case trigger), and
``draft_revision`` is a content hash suitable for optimistic concurrency.

put.description:
Replace the workflow's draft with the supplied document.

Validates the definition, then rewrites the action graph, layout,
schedules, and case trigger in one transaction. Omit ``schedules`` from
the document to leave the workflow's schedules untouched (they can be
managed independently via ``/schedules``). Publishing is separate: call
``POST /workflows/{id}/commit`` afterwards to create a new version.

CaseQuery.title: CaseQuery
CaseQuery.description:
Matching criteria shared by case search and filtered status counts.

Explicit text, identity, and hierarchy constraints are combined with
``filters`` using AND. Workspace and entitlement checks belong to the
service and cannot be supplied or negated by this request.

Tag membership uses existing filter nodes: ``in`` matches any tag, an
``and`` of ``contains`` conditions requires all tags, and ``not`` around
``in`` excludes the selected tags. ``is_null`` matches no tags.

Scalar dropdown/custom-field exclusions retain SQL NULL semantics:
``ne``, ``not_in``, and negated comparisons exclude unset values. Include
unset values explicitly with an ``or`` containing ``is_null``.

FleetSocKeyCreate.title: FleetSocKeyCreate
FleetSocKeyCreate.description:
Create a SOC key.

Fleet keys are online: generated on the server, or imported from a secret
key file. Approval keys are ``offline`` (recommended: only the public key
file is registered and approvals are signed by the operator who holds the
secret) or ``online`` (generated on the server; lower assurance). An
approval key's secret is never imported.

id (printable ASCII, 1-128 characters) and defaults to the derived id.
